page.overview:
Who is Lizard League?

Iguana † Komodo Dragon † Salamander † Gecko (M.I.A) Gila Monster (M.I.A)

The Lizard League are a lizard-themed supervillain terrorist group. They are adversaries of several superhero teams, including the Fight Force and the Guardians of the Globe.
